frase_gancho.texto: People of the clouds and people of the rain: two worlds that left behind tombs, gold, and carved stone.

introduccion_narrativa.texto: Oaxaca holds the history of two peoples. The Zapotecs, who called themselves the people of the clouds, built Monte Albán on the leveled summit of a group of hills. The Mixtecs, the people of the rain, were great goldsmiths. In this hall you will see funerary urns, a re-created tomb, the reliefs of the Danzantes, and the objects that Alfonso Caso found in Tomb 7. There is also a panel with stepped fret patterns, the style that became a symbol of Mitla.
